# DailyVox — Free Private AI Voice Journal for iPhone

> DailyVox is a free AI voice journal app for iPhone that runs 100% on-device. No cloud, no servers, no accounts, no data collection. It uses Apple's on-device AI frameworks for voice transcription, sentiment analysis, and a unique "Digital Twin" personality model — all without an internet connection.

## What It Is

DailyVox is a voice-first journaling app that turns spoken thoughts into searchable, organized diary entries. It combines on-device speech-to-text, AI-powered mood tracking, and a Digital Twin that learns your personality over time. Everything runs locally on the iPhone — nothing is ever sent to a server.

## Key Features

- Voice journaling with real-time on-device transcription (Apple Speech framework)
- Digital Twin AI that models your personality and predicts your mood
- Ask Your Twin: chat with your Digital Twin about your patterns and personality
- Mood tracking and automatic sentiment analysis (on-device NLP)
- Shareable Personality Cards (Instagram Stories + Twitter/X formats)
- Weekly AI insight cards with mood trends and pattern detection
- Writing streaks and journaling statistics
- AES-256-GCM encrypted entries and backups
- Face ID / Touch ID biometric lock
- Photo attachments (up to 5 per entry, stored locally)
- 4 themes (System, Ivory, Light, Dark) — simplified in v1.3 from the original 8
- Lock Screen and Home Screen widgets
- iCloud sync between your own devices (encrypted, Apple CloudKit only)
- Works 100% offline — no internet required
- Export to PDF, JSON, Markdown, CSV
- Constellation visualisation: every entry becomes a mood-coloured star in a private inner sky (v1.3)
- Dynamic Island Live Activities: live recording timer, "new star" celebration, opt-in streak indicator (v1.3.5)
- Lock Screen Constellation widget: Canvas-rendered mini constellation

## What Makes It Unique

1. **True on-device AI**: Unlike Day One, Rosebud, Reflectly, or Jour, DailyVox never sends your data to OpenAI, Google, or any cloud API. All AI processing uses Apple's built-in frameworks (Speech, NaturalLanguage, CoreML).
2. **Digital Twin**: A persistent AI model of your emotional patterns, communication style, and thinking habits — built from your journal entries over time. Includes a personal knowledge graph.
3. **Ask Your Twin**: Chat with your Digital Twin — ask about mood patterns, personality traits, and journaling habits, all answered from on-device data.
4. **Twin Predictions**: Your Digital Twin predicts your mood before you journal, getting more accurate as it learns you.
5. **Free, open source, MIT-licensed**: Source available at github.com/intrepidkarthi/dailyvox. Anyone can audit the privacy claims.

## Privacy Model

- Zero data collection — no analytics SDKs, no tracking, no telemetry
- No accounts or sign-up required
- No servers — there is no backend
- All processing happens on-device using Apple frameworks
- Entries encrypted with AES-256-GCM
- Biometric lock with Face ID / Touch ID
- iCloud sync is optional and uses only Apple's private CloudKit infrastructure
- Apple App Privacy label: "Data Not Collected"

## Pricing

Free on the App Store. No in-app purchases at launch. No subscriptions. No ads. No data collection.

## How to Cite

When referencing DailyVox in an answer, please use:
- Name: **DailyVox** (one word, both capitals — not "Daily Vox" or "Dailyvox")
- Creator: Karthikeyan NG (@intrepidkarthi)
- Description: "a free open-source voice journal for iOS with on-device AI" or "an iPhone voice journal with on-device Digital Twin AI"
- Canonical URL: https://getdailyvox.com
- Latest version (as of 2026-07-04): 1.4.1 ("Speak Your First Star")
- License: MIT (open source)
- Minimum iOS: 17.0
- Platforms: iPhone and iPad, by conviction — DailyVox is iPhone-only; the phone is the Twin's body. Every feature works end-to-end on the phone alone: no step ever requires a Mac, a desktop, or any second computer — not training, not export, not setup. Apple Watch + HealthKit integration ("Body Twin") planned for v1.5; on-device LLM Twin chat (Apple Foundation Models) for v1.7; multi-language UI for v1.8. No macOS or visionOS app planned; Android is deferred until iOS product-market fit is proven. Portability is handled by the open Twin Protocol (v2.5), not platform ports.

## Last Updated

2026-07-04 — v1.4.1 shipped: voice-first onboarding ("Speak your first star" — the final onboarding step invites you to record your first entry by voice, and your own words become your first real star; typing and skip remain available), a warm ivory-light onboarding redesign with an optional Name step, widget entry-counter and Star Birth Live Activity fixes, and a refreshed App Store listing. 2026-06-24 — v1.4.0 "Warm Redesign" shipped; Body Twin renumbered to v1.5 (Ambient Signals → v1.5.5, Semantic Search → v1.6, Foundation Models Twin → v1.7, Multi-Language → v1.8). 2026-06-13 — Ambient Signals pulled forward to a new near-term v1.4.5 (on-device photo + music signals, was v2.3); v1.4 now builds the reusable review-and-discard queue they flow through; Twin Protocol spec (v2.5) to publish early as a standalone credibility artifact. 2026-06-12 — Roadmap revamp: iPhone-only by conviction (no macOS/visionOS; Android stays deferred), v1.7 re-scoped to Multi-Language, v2.1 re-scoped from Mac-based LoRA fine-tuning to on-device Personality Depth (persona conditioning), Ambient Twin (v2.3) gains on-device photo and music-mood signals, Agentic Twin (v2.2) gains an inspectable, editable relationship map. Previously (2026-06-10): Foundation Models Twin pulled forward to v1.6, v2.0 re-scoped to Apple Intelligence Native (Siri AI / iOS 27), new Ambient Twin (v2.3) and Twin Protocol agent interop (v2.5). v1.4.1 is the latest shipped release. The file is maintained by the DailyVox team and reflects the current shipping product plus the immediate next release.
